The structure of Pr2Co5Ga crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with eight atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies two main Co environments: one with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Co, 3 Ga, 3 Pr) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, and another with 14 neighbors (8 Co, 2 Ga, 4 Pr). Ga is coordinated by 9 neighbors (6 Co, 3 Pr), while Pr has 15 neighbors (9 Co, 6 Ga). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts among Co 12-vertex polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between Co 12- and 14-vertex polyhedra.
